name: Envelope
description: Small-business payroll. Persistent company records and payroll access are partial; calculation, payments and filings are not implemented.

externals.why: Owner-controlled Worker hosting and D1 storage. The owner supplies account authority and holds installation bindings; company private records use the independent payroll record key. Optional native email uses only the configured account and credential. See ./docs/payroll-external-data.md for custody.
data: configured native authentication mail when Cloudflare mail is selected
externals.name: Cloudflare hosting and native mail

externals.why: Owner-opted-in redacted tax-notice proposals only; never payroll calculation or approval. The company credential is encrypted in owner D1 with the independent record key. Requests set store:false; OpenAI processing and retention follow owner terms.
externals.name: OpenAI notice proposals

externals.why: Configured native sign-in, invitation and sensitive-change mail, plus exact human-approved notice correspondence. Installation mail credentials stay in owner Worker bindings; company notice credentials are encrypted in D1. Resend holds delivery data under owner terms.
externals.name: Resend mail

externals.why: Alternative explicitly configured native authentication mail transport. The owner supplies the API credential in installation bindings; SendGrid holds messages and delivery metadata under owner terms. No payroll record or private identifier is needed.
externals.name: SendGrid native mail
Run Edit Run managed mail
externals.why: Configured managed sign-in, invitation and sensitive-change mail. The assigned relay receives only the intended recipient, subject and message. Its sender and installation identity are assigned by Run Edit Run; the private installation credential stays in owner Worker bindings. Company notice correspondence uses its separately approved provider.

Optional owner-linked identity issuer, selected and reviewed in native sign-in settings. Discovery, token, key and link endpoints stay on the approved issuer origin. Installation signing keys stay in owner D1; only signed client assertions leave. Identity processing follows the selected issuer terms.
data: client identifier and signed client assertion
externals.name: Linked identity provider

externals.why: Banking, verification and payroll rails: Check or Gusto Embedded; an owner-selected bank verification service; separately authorized international payout, payroll card, instant pay and earned wage access partners. Intended purpose and minimum fields are prospective obligations under ENV-004, ENV-011, ENV-013, ENV-035, ENV-036, ENV-065, ENV-087 and ENV-088; this declaration enables no request. Owner-signed operator and rail agreements, employer mandates, authorized tenant and separately scoped bank credentials. No partner is selected or credential accepted by the current payroll controls.
data: No data is sent by this unavailable connection. Planned minimum: Exact approved employer and worker payment instructions, verified destinations, amounts, dates, idempotency identities and reconciliation receipts.
externals.name: Banking, verification and payroll rails

externals.why: Tax and identity agencies: IRS, EFTPS, SSA wage reporting and SSNVS, IRIS, all applicable state, DC and local agencies, NASWA SIDES and authorized state portals. Intended purpose and minimum fields are prospective obligations under ENV-002, ENV-014, ENV-015, ENV-016, ENV-017, ENV-037, ENV-069 and ENV-071; this declaration enables no request. Employer-specific enrollment, signed agency authority and scoped submitter credentials are required. Current prepared forms and manual SIDES handoff are not an automated agency connection.
data: No data is sent by this unavailable connection. Planned minimum: Only employer and worker identifiers, approved wage and tax fields, period, signed authority and the exact agency request or response.
externals.name: Tax and identity agencies

externals.why: Retirement and benefits recordkeepers: Guideline, Human Interest, Vestwell, Betterment at Work, Ubiquity, CalSavers, OregonSaves, Illinois Secure Choice and other applicable mandated programs. Intended purpose and minimum fields are prospective obligations under ENV-019, ENV-043 and ENV-042; this declaration enables no request. Owner-authorized plan connections and least-privilege recordkeeper credentials remain unimplemented; no credential or contribution is sent.
data: No data is sent by this unavailable connection. Planned minimum: Approved participant identity, plan and election, payroll period, contribution, match, correction and acceptance reference.
externals.name: Retirement and benefits recordkeepers

externals.why: Carriers, state funds and benefit administrators: NEXT, AP Intego, Pie, The Hartford, Washington L&I, Ohio BWC, North Dakota WSI, Wyoming DWS, Oregon combined payroll, NYSIF, authorized HI and NY plan carriers, Employee Navigator and the owner-contracted ACA administrator or AIR partner. Intended purpose and minimum fields are prospective obligations under ENV-019, ENV-021, ENV-043 and ENV-042; this declaration enables no request. An actual employer policy, fund enrollment, plan authority or contracted filing account is required. Underwriting and coverage remain with the insurer; no live carrier or AIR credentials are accepted.
data: No data is sent by this unavailable connection. Planned minimum: Approved employer and worker identity, work state, risk class, exposure hours, wages, plan elections, capped contributions and required reporting period.
externals.name: Carriers, state funds and benefit administrators

externals.why: HR and employment sources: Willow, BambooHR, Rippling HRIS and HiBob. Intended purpose and minimum fields are prospective obligations under ENV-040 and ENV-042; this declaration enables no request. Source owners keep employment and policy custody. Current reviewed uploads are inbound records only; future live sync requires owner-authorized source credentials and exact destination review.
data: No data is sent by this unavailable connection. Planned minimum: Payroll-required worker identity, reviewed effective compensation, work location, leave, benefit and termination versions; restricted payroll acknowledgements.
externals.name: HR and employment sources

externals.why: Time and point of sale sources: Lanyard, Deputy, Homebase, When I Work, 7shifts, QuickBooks Time, Clockify, Toast, Square and Clover. Intended purpose and minimum fields are prospective obligations under ENV-008 and ENV-042; this declaration enables no request. Current reviewed files do not grant live source access. Each future adapter needs owner-authorized credentials, source mappings and exact destination review.
data: No data is sent by this unavailable connection. Planned minimum: Approved source identity and version, worker, workweek, jurisdiction, hours, earning codes, typed tips and correction references.
externals.name: Time and point of sale sources

externals.why: Accounting ledgers: Pantry, QuickBooks Online, Xero, NetSuite and Sage Intacct. Intended purpose and minimum fields are prospective obligations under ENV-023 and ENV-042; this declaration enables no request. The owner controls each ledger and its least-privilege posting credential. No ledger credential or outbound posting is implemented.
data: No data is sent by this unavailable connection. Planned minimum: Reviewed balanced payroll journals, liability and clearing accounts, restricted dimensions, run version, posting identity and accepted correction references.
externals.name: Accounting ledgers

externals.why: Inkwell signatures: Inkwell. Intended purpose and minimum fields are prospective obligations under ENV-044 and ENV-065; this declaration enables no request. A named employer mandate and authorized Inkwell connection are required. No signing credential, automatic signature or outbound document exchange is implemented.
data: No data is sent by this unavailable connection. Planned minimum: Only the exact reviewed reporting-agent or debit mandate, document version, signer identity, signature status and revocation reference.
externals.name: Inkwell signatures

externals.why: SMS, chat and push: An owner-selected SMS service, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Apple push and Google push. Intended purpose and minimum fields are prospective obligations under ENV-022, ENV-044, ENV-045 and ENV-065; this declaration enables no request. Each channel requires explicit owner authorization and scoped service or organization signing credentials held in owner-controlled storage. No SMS, chat or push credential or transport is implemented.
data: No data is sent by this unavailable connection. Planned minimum: Minimal intended recipient, private installation link, publication status and accountable deadline contact; no salary, SSN, bank value or tax attachment in channel previews.
externals.name: SMS, chat and push

externals.why: Job earnings and practice handoffs: Gauge, Plinth, Glove, Mallet, Strap, Orbit, Easel, Coaster, Expensify, Blotter and Crank. Intended purpose and minimum fields are prospective obligations under ENV-029, ENV-036, ENV-041, ENV-042 and ENV-044; this declaration enables no request. Reviewed source files and downloaded firm handoffs remain under human control. Future outbound exchange needs current field grants, owner-authorized destination and scoped credentials; no live sibling transport is implemented.
data: No data is sent by this unavailable connection. Planned minimum: Approved unpaid earning identity and version, permitted reconciled labor actuals, reimbursement payment ownership, scoped client deadline links and preparation status.
externals.name: Job earnings and practice handoffs
Owner-consented proposal webhook receiver
externals.why: Reference-only uncalculated proposal events to the exact administrator-pinned receiver after explicit native owner consent and an audited send. Signing secrets are encrypted in company storage and excluded from archives; receiver retention and deduplication are controlled by its operator. No automatic delivery, compensation, payment or filing data.

deploy.notes: Native owner sessions guard /app; unknown paths return real 404s; development and demo mail is suppressed.
